description: Fix Django security warnings and critical configuration issues by updating settings.py to properly configure HSTS, SSL redirect, CSRF cookies, session security, and SECRET_KEY validation
steps: Update projectshub/settings.py security configuration to fix Django system check warnings
Set SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000 when not DEBUG and IS_PRODUCTION
Ensure SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT is properly set to True in production environments
Fix SECRET_KEY validation to require proper length and complexity in production
Set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True and CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True when not DEBUG
Update CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS configuration for Django 4.2+ compliance
Review and optimize middleware order for security and performance
Add proper environment variable validation with clear error messages
acceptance_criteria: Running 'python manage.py check --deploy' shows no security warnings
All security headers are properly set in non-DEBUG mode
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS works correctly with the configured domains
SECRET_KEY validation prevents weak keys in production
findings: Django system check identified 6 security warnings related to HSTS, SSL redirect, SECRET_KEY validation, and secure cookie settings. These are critical for production deployment security.
